SubjectA Resolution adopting the City of Tampa Capital Improvement Budget and 
Program for FY2026 through FY2030; Providing an effective date.
Resolution / 
Ordinance 
Title
A Resolution adopting the City of Tampa Capital Improvement Budget and 
Program for FY2026 through FY2030; Providing an effective date.
BACKGROUND:
The City's FY2026 Capital Improvement Program contains capital improvement projects 
totaling $422,138,440.  The City's FY2026 - FY2030 Capital Improvement Program contains 
capital improvement projects totaling $1,719,951,757. This resolution adopts the FY2026 
through FY2030 Recommended Capital Improvement Budget and Program as required by 
Florida Statutes and City Charter. In addition, it adopts the FY2026 portion of the FY2026 
through FY2030 Capital Improvement Projects program as part of the FY2026 Annual Budget 
in the amount of $422,138,440.
FISCAL IMPACT: Yes
FISCAL IMPACT STATEMENT:
This resolution adopts the FY2026 through FY2030 Recommended Capital Improvement 
Budget and Program in the amount of $1,719,951,757 as required by Florida Statutes and 
City Charter.  In addition, it adopts the FY2026 portion of the FY2026 through FY2030 Capital 
Improvement Projects program as part of the FY2026 Annual Budget in the amount of 
$422,138,440.
PROJECTED COSTS: $422,138,440 (FY2026)
